cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'earned it' under my quiz trophy photo. Nobody else buzzed in as decisively as I did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You copied me pressing the red button. I was testing whether my buzzer worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, checked and ready. The question came straight after, and I answered it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said 'sparrow' before they even showed the bird.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say I recognized it early. Don't write 'lucky guess' under a trophy I won.
